blocks.text: Ultrasound imaging bohat se medical fields (shobon) mein diagnosis ke liye istemal hoti hai. Obstetrics (pregnancy aur delivery ka shoba) mein fetus ki growth (barhna) dekhi jati hai, gestational age (hamal ki umar) ka andaza lagaya jata hai aur pregnancy mein abnormalities (kharabiyon) ki pehchan hoti hai. Abdomen (pet) mein liver (jigar), kidneys (gurde), gallbladder (pitta), pancreas aur bladder (masana) jaise zaroori organs dekhe jate hain. Cardiology (dil ka shoba) mein echo cardiography se doctors dil ki structure (banawat) aur kaam real time mein dekhte hain. Urology mein prostate, testicles aur urinary system (peshab ka nizam) ki jaanch hoti hai. Musculoskeletal system (muscles aur haddiyan) mein ligament ki injury (chot), joints ki inflammation (sozish, soojan) aur soft tissues ki doosri bimariyon ki pehchan hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Pulse bhejne ke 65 microsecond baad echo wapas aati hai. Agar tissue mein awaz ki speed 1540 m s⁻¹ ho to boundary kitni gehri (depth) hai?

items: Ultrasound (1-15 MHz) alag acoustic impedance wale tissues ki boundaries se reflect hota hai; echo ka time aur intensity image banate hain.
Depth d = vt/2; strong echo zyada bright.
Image quality: impedance ka farq, frequency (resolution ya depth), gel.
Applications: pregnancy, pet ke organs, dil (echo cardiography), urology, muscles aur joints.
